OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^(\D*\d){10}\D*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rule by adding a single new, self-contained class: `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/advice/OwnerUniqueHouseholdAdvice.java`.

**How it works** — it mirrors the existing `OwnerUniqueTelephoneAdvice` pattern (`@ControllerAdvice` + `RequestBodyAdvice`, auto-detected by component scan, so no wiring changes elsewhere):

- `supports(...)` limits it to the `addOwner` (create) endpoint, so updates are unaffected.
- The `sharesHousehold` flag isn't a mapped owner field, so I read it from the raw request body in `beforeBodyRead`: buffer the bytes, parse the JSON tree, then re-supply the bytes to the downstream converter so normal deserialization still works.

**Structural impact:** everything lives in one new file with small, cohesive methods (each low cyclomatic complexity, minimal WMC_other since the class is new and tiny). No existing method or class was modified, keeping the cost near its floor.
